listings.description:
Rapid Red Metallic! 2 owners, I bought it certified preowned with 21,900 miles 4/2024, it has 37,400 miles now. There should be some transferable warrentee for power train. Always stored under cover in the winter. It is in fantastic shape and needs nothing. The maintenence is up to date which has been synthetic oil changes and a new battery 6 months ago. - 10 speed auto with paddle shift
- Heated and cooled seats
- Heated Wheel
- Lane departure warning.
- Car cover included
- All programmable dash and LED colors
It has been a great summer car, I'm 62 and have not abused it in any way, never seen a track day. Insurance is not bad, and MPG is ~20 surprisingly good. Clean tiitle and no accidents.
Interior is perfect, back seats are unused because they are unusable for people over ~3 feet tall... under the hood is clean, trunk is amazingly big!
Only reason for sale is want to buy a C7 Corvette just to change things up a little, I love sports cars. This color Rapid Red + PP1 is kind of rare and definately has the look to set it apart, I have not seen another one around Mpls. 
The PP1 cars like this are the ones to get over a normal GT or GT premium: 
 - Performance Wheels & Tires: 19×9" front and 19×9.5" rear Ebony Black-painted aluminum wheels 
255/40R19 (front) and 275/40R19 (rear). Tires are in great shape, about 15K on them.
 - Braking Upgrades: Brembo™ six‑piston front brake calipers with large rotors 
 - Suspension & Chassis: Heavy‑duty front springs, K‑brace (steeda) for improved chassis rigidity, Strut‑tower brace.
 - Cooling: Larger radiator for improved heat dissipation 
 - Aero & Styling: Functional rear spoiler, Larger front lip and side skirts.
 - Interior & Instrumentation: Engine‑spun aluminum instrument panel.
 - Gauge pack: Vacuum and Oil Pressure gage upper center of dash.
 - Heavy duty sway bar
I did 2 modifications: These 2 "bolt ons" are a big improvement for the Coyote Engine that required no change to tune or engine modification and didn't affect warentee - Just help it breath in and flow out better, adding ~15 HP, taking it from 460 to ~475 hp. 
 - Corsa cold air intake. The OEM air box is included. This just flows and sounds better far better for intake. $435
 - Borla 60662 SwitchFire X-Pipe Exhaust Pipe. The OEM H pipe also does not flow smoothly. This thing sounds amazing and should for $600. The active exhaust is all retaind so you can program Quiet, Normal, Sport, Track. The cold start will let the neighbors know when you are going to work! Or you can program it or start quiet in the morning.

listings.title: 2014 Scion Xb Wagon
listings.description:
Selling my Toaster. 
Those that know Xb’s love them. Same here, this box is awesome.
 The Only reason I’m selling it is that I’m out of driveway space. 
The car is mostly OEM. I updated most of the lights to LED. 
I have stayed up to date on scheduled maintenance per the maintenance schedule book. 
Plugs replaced recently (per maintenance schedule)
Oil was changed approx 200 miles ago. Same with transmission fluid. It has been done every 80,000 miles. 
Currently on odo is just over 180,000. These Toyota cars easily get 250,000. There is a lot of life left in it. 
It has had 2 accidents. First was an inattentive driver entering the road and hit the car in the driver side rear wheel. Repair was new wheel and rear fender cover. 
The 2nd was this last winter when a deer was hit at 30mph. The repair was new front bumper cover, passenger fender, wheel-well liner some other plastic parts and I replaced both headlights at the same time since it was apart and easy. 
These box’s are simple to work on which makes them popular in the mod circles. 
Currently averaging 29-30 mpg. 
It pulls hard to 100mph. 
This is a great car, tons of interior space, is safe and maintained. 
Only way to appreciate it is to try it. 
Price is negotiable but I do have a low limit and I’m not desperate to unload the car. 
Until it sells, this is still a daily driver. Weekdays it will be in Green Lake; evenings and weekends it is in Omro. 
Call and text is best. If you call, leave a message and I’ll call back as fast as I can. 
Single owner and never left Wisconsin. 
910 (yes, fort Bragg area code- I won’t change it) 
551-388 four. 
Jon

listings.description: Hello. Here we have a fun old car looking for a good home. This was my father’s car and has been in storage for years as he attempted to get it going but never did. Recently I had the electrical system completely replaced and checked and it now starts and runs very well although it needs brakes yet before it can be driven. It has a 215 aluminum V8 engine and a muncie 4-speed transmission, console plate with factory tachometer, fresh interior that has been cleaned via ozone, and it is a very sold car. I just got it out this morning and it fired right up. All of the lights are equipment work, including the tachometer. A new neutral safety switch was wired in as well as a reverse light switch. The dome/courtesy lights work and the glove box lamp as well. The exhaust is solid and we discovered a problem with the oiling system and it now holds great oil pressure. The radiator is solid and it has fresh coolant. The body is from the south and I spent many hours getting it straight some 20 odd years ago and the paint ( by BASF Glasseuit) still shines beautifully. The tires are in good shape but I cannot guarantee that they will be roadworthy. We are open to reasonable offers. The car is sold as is. Inspect the pictures carefully. Thanks for looking

listings.description:
Own a piece of automotive history with this authentic 1966 Ford Mustang GT 2+2 Fastback. A true survivor vehicle, it features its original A-Code 289 CID 4BBL V8 engine paired with a classic 4-speed manual transmission. Carefully maintained within a private collection for over two decades, this vintage muscle car combines incredible originality with reliable performance.
The exterior is dressed in a factory-correct Turquoise Metallic paint finish applied over 20 years ago, highlighting excellent chrome accents, trim, and all-original glass. Inside, the cabin features the iconic original turquoise-and-white Pony Interior, complete with comfortable bucket seats, a full center console, a convenient fold-down rear seat, rally pack gauges, and a factory tachometer. All interior lights and the clock remain fully operational.
Further adding to its charm, this classic fastback includes a Cobra engine dress-up kit, an unmodified trunk and undercarriage, classic rally wheels, and a preserved 1979 Georgia State inspection sticker pointing to its rich Southern heritage. Freshly serviced with a new fuel tank, fresh fluids, a professional tune-up, new tires, and a replacement battery, this vintage Mustang GT Fastback is completely ready to drive, show, and enjoy. listings.title: 2003 MINI Cooper S
listings.description:
2003 Mini Cooper S
Very clean, 38 mpg, COLD A/C, HOT heat, Supercharged with 6 speed manual. Very fun car to drive!
Background on the car- Bought the car from a 45 year old Mini Cooper enthusiast. He was very meticulous and knew absolutely everything about a Mini Cooper a guy could know, and he had a few different Mini's. He did the normal tasteful modifications to the car for a Mini Cooper of its Era as well as maintenance too. Supercharger oil, pulley, Alta tune, Alta air filter, cat back exhuast, Cooling fan relay mod, larger intercooler. I have had zero issues with the car in the last several years ive owned it. My Wife and I just drove it out to Green Bay, WI recently (4.5hr one way; 9hr round trip). Thats how dependable and trustworthy it is... and we have 3 other daily drivers to use. I just drive it and listen to the cool supercharger noises. I dont beat on it, I never race it, I just drive it to commute around (it fits everywhere) and its fun to drive around. 
-Car is equipped with the fuel efficient 1.6L Supercharged 4 cylinder engine. Powerful and peppy powertrain for the car. The car is rated at 38MPG on the highway and around 29MPG in city type driving and it gets at least that if not better. Very smooth and comfortable car with regular maintenance completed. I bought the car about 3 years ago because I've always wanted a Mini, fun to drive, it fits in any parking spot, and the great fuel mileage. Car has mostly been commuted on the freeway and has very well maintained easy highway miles... has roughly 161k miles on it. Has newer brakes, oil change, etc recently done.
-Mechanically the car is great in my opinion considering the age. The engine runs as smooth as a swiss watch and has all of the power that it did like it was new (actually significantly more). Has no issues that would need attention (just drove it 9hrs round trip)!! The transmission shifts perfectly and nice and smooth, clutch is in good shape and it is very easy to drive. The steering is nice and tight and drives straight down the road. The brakes are powerful and responsive (newer). The suspension rides great and is tight and comfortable. Tires are still good, about 70% tread remaining. HOT Heat and COLD A/C!!!!!!
It is a 2003 Mini so with that its not perfect but miniscule such as the parking brake needs to be adjusted, the drivers window needs to be adjusted (I put a window regulator in and I didnt get it adjusted perfect but its very close), could use a valve cover gasket if you wanted but not needed right away. Id drive it to any state in the country today from AZ to FL to NY and not think twice. 
-Car is equipped nicely.... Heated seats (very hot and work great), power windows, power locks, power mirrors, Great Stereo, Navigation that does work, Map lights, rear seats fold down, CRUISE CONTROL, 6 way adjust seat, Lots of storage compartments, remote trunk release, Keyless entry, and much more that im sure im forgetting.
-The interior is in great shape and clean, no major staining. It has the rare and sought after blue leather interior. Nearly no visible signs of any type of wear on the seats, carpet, buttons etc. It really is that nice. the car has been kept perfectly clean and treated with respect. Everything on the interior works... windows, buttons, lights etc, everything.
-The exterior is clean for the year of the vehicle. Paint has a great glossy shine to it. Has no major body damage or major dents. Car was always kept clean on the outside just like it was on the inside and it shows. It does have the typical parking lot door ding and scratch/scuff... you have to look for them but they are there here or there. Minor rust bubble on the rear but nothing major or noticeable. 
Very reliable car that needs nothing but a driver. All maintenance done and is ready to go. We would drive this car across country over and over and not think twice.
Clean and clear title in hand signed and ready to go.

listings.description:
2004 Lexus ES 330 with 220,550 miles. Had this car for about 3-4 years and put about 40,000 miles on it. I got a truck and took car off insurance it's been sitting for a few months, and I want to sell it.
Engine and transmission are strong, tires have life and tread, breaks are good for a bit, suspension is tight it's a very reliable, trustworthy car.
I will list the flaws just so no surprises 
-small exhaust leak gets quiter when engine warms up not loud enough to get pulled over or anything
-valve covers seep some oil
-when going over about 60mph there is a rattling coming from the steering column it doesn't affect handling or steering but it is somewhat annoying i just turn up music or roll down windows
-rear windows don't roll down
-front cup holder wont pop out and if it does it won't hold drinks i just use the rear ones.
-I refurbished the battery as it was dead when I went to get it ready for 
sale its working and starting/holding a charge but in the future you may need to replace
-rust on driver's side quarter panel and some scuffs here and there.
it's a very cheap reliable car id trust to take me anywhere
message me with any questions may be best to text me at show contact info

listings.description:
For sale is my 2012 Ford Focus SEL in pearlescent white with a unique two-tone white and black interior. This car has been a reliable daily driver for me since 2014 and is packed with technology and features that were well ahead of their time when it was built.
Highlights
Transmission replaced at 60,000 miles (factory recall)
Battery replaced in June 2026
Brand-new Hankook tires installed in June 2026
Unique two-tone white/black interior
Premium audio system with upgraded speakers
Factory-installed subwoofer
Bluetooth connectivity
Voice controls
Built-in Ford SYNC software with large screen
Rear backup camera
Factory remote start, perfect for Minnesota winters and hot summer days
Excellent fuel economy. I've gotten ~45mpg highway
Comfortable and fun to drive
Clean Minnesota title
The Focus remains one of the best-driving compact cars of its era, with responsive handling and a comfortable ride. 
Known Issues
I believe in being upfront about the vehicle's condition:
Rear struts should be replaced in the next couple years, followed by an alignment
Rear camera/ passenger brake light circuit currently needs troubleshooting
These items have been factored into the asking price and should be straightforward repairs for someone looking for an affordable commuter, first car, or project.
The factory remote start is one of my favorite features, making cold Minnesota winter mornings and hot summer afternoons much more comfortable.
Overall
This is a clean, well-equipped Focus with a great interior, upgraded audio, and brand-new tires. With a little attention to the maintenance items listed above, it still has plenty of life left and offers a lot of features for the money.
Feel free to contact me with any questions or to arrange a time to see the vehicle.

listings.description:
2008 Honda Odyssey EX – Clean Title – 193k Miles – No rust
Description:
Selling a reliable, highly versatile 2008 Honda Odyssey EX with a clean title in hand. This van runs great and has plenty of life left, making it the perfect choice for a family hauler, road-tripper, or winter vehicle.
Key Vehicle Details:
• Mileage: 193,944 miles
• Engine: 3.5L V6 i-VTEC (Runs strong and smooth)
• Title: Clean title
• Tires: Toyo 3pmsf tires with deep, healthy tread left
• Battery: Brand new/recent EverStart Value battery (600 CCA)
Major Maintenance Note:
• Timing belt replaced at 114,000 miles (verified by the service sticker in the engine bay). This is a huge piece of preventative maintenance already taken care of for this generation of Odyssey!
• Has a leaking power steering pump. Can be fixed fairly cheap, just don't have time for it.
Premium EX Features Included:
• WeatherTech protective all-weather floor mats (Excellent for Minnesota winters!)
• Dual power sliding rear doors (controls on the dash and key fob).
• Tri-Zone automatic climate control (separate driver, passenger, and rear controls).
• 6-disc in-dash CD changer with AM/FM/AUX input.
• Third-row "Magic Seats" fold completely flat into the floor effortlessly for massive cargo flexibility.
Condition:
The van is in solid overall condition for its age and mileage. Runs great. Clean cloth interior. It has a minor scuff/slight bumper gap on the front driver-side corner (as pictured), but it does not affect driving or functionality at all. One passenger door occasionally sticks but still works. No rust underneath!

2008 RAM 4500 HD DUALLY AMBULANCE — 6.7L CUMMINS | REBUILT AISIN | KELDERMAN AIR RIDE
CLEAN TITLE IN HAND — NO CHECK ENGINE LIGHT — TURN-KEY & READY TO ROLL
Up for sale is a rock-solid, heavy-duty 2008 Ram 4500 HD Chassis Cab Dually (2WD) equipped with a massive 12'6" x 8' all-aluminum modular ambulance box. Built with the factory Ambulance Prep Package, this truck spent the majority of its service life as a 911 ambulance in Houston, Texas—far away from northern road salt and the Rust Belt—and was later maintained as part of our dedicated special-event medical fleet, seeing way fewer miles per year than a standard 24/7 city ambulance.
Taken out of service Nov 8, 2026. It runs and drives great, has zero warning lights on the dash, shows very well for a 2008, and needs nothing mechanically.
WHY THIS RIG IS A GOLDMINE (4 WAYS TO USE IT):
• ULTIMATE OVERLAND / RV CAMPER BUILD: Pre-insulated all-aluminum box, dual A/C & heat systems, onboard 1000W inverter, shore power hookup, and air-ride suspension. Half the camper build is already done for you.
• HEAVY-DUTY WORK TRUCK / MOBILE WORKSHOP: Lockable exterior compartments (all tied into keyless entry), tons of interior cabinetry/storage, and onboard 110V power for tools.
• TOW RIG / CHASSIS CAB SWAP: Pull the box off and drop a flatbed or hauler bed on it. With the 6.7L Cummins, built Aisin trans, 19.5" commercial wheels, and Kelderman air ride, it's an absolute beast.
• BUILT-IN SCRAP VALUE: If you just want the Ram 4500 chassis, the heavy-gauge box is 100% aluminum, the medical inverter can be scrapped, and there are miles of heavy-gauge copper wiring inside to recoup serious cash back.
========================================
ENGINE, DRIVETRAIN & FRESH MAINTENANCE
========================================
• Engine: 6.7L Cummins Turbo Diesel — 276,000 miles (fires right up, runs strong and smooth, NO check engine light)
• Transmission: Rebuilt Commercial Aisin AS68RC 6-Speed Automatic (Rebuilt at 260k miles in 2018 — full receipts in hand!)
• Drivetrain: 2WD Dual Rear Wheel on 19.5" Commercial Wheels & Tires
• Fresh Maintenance (August 2026):
 - Brand-new Water Pump
 - New Serpentine Belt
 - Complete Coolant System Flush
 - Dual AGM Batteries (installed 2025)
ABOUT THE AISIN AS68RC COMMERCIAL TRANSMISSION:
Unlike standard pickups that came with light-duty transmissions, Ram equipped the 4500 Chassis Cab with the commercial medium-duty Aisin AS68RC 6-speed automatic. Built for continuous heavy hauling (26,000 lb GCWR rated), it features oversized internal gear sets, a multi-disc lock-up converter, its own standalone TCM for aggressive exhaust-brake downshifting, and factory PTO ports.
The original transmission made it to 260,000 miles—definitely serving its purpose—before being professionally rebuilt in 2018 (full receipts in hand). The shop rebuilt it using genuine Aisin clutch packs and addressed the ONLY two known weak spots on these transmissions:
• Upgraded HD Billet Torque Converter
• Upgraded Billet Input Shaft
• Brand-new factory transmission cooler and lines
========================================
RUST-FREE TEXAS HISTORY & CLIMATE
========================================
This truck spent the majority of its service life in the warm, dry climate of Houston, Texas as a 911 unit—meaning no harsh northern winters, no road salt, and no Rust Belt undercarriage rot. Since then, it has been fleet-maintained as a low-annual-mileage special-event medical unit.

CHASSIS, SUSPENSION & TOWING
========================================

listings.title: 2006 Hyundai Tucson Limited
listings.description:
This is a one owner car being sold by the original owner. The 2.7 liter V6 engine runs great. We have always serviced and repaired any mechanical problems with this vehicle. This includes, within its most recent 13,000 miles, a front brake job, installation of good new tires, full repair of the exhaust system, a new starter assembly and wiring harness, new engine and cabin air filters, a new battery, a new power steering system hose and new rear brake lines and a rear brake job. The oil and filter were most recently changed last month. All electrical systems, lights, indicators and controls, including the audio system (6 CD changer, cassette, AM/FM) and sunroof work except as noted below.
 The parking brake froze several years ago, and we had it disabled on the advice of our mechanic. The car holds fine in park.
 The “TPMS” (Tire Pressure Monitoring System) dashboard light is stuck on. The tires have less than 13,000 miles, and we regularly check the tire pressure, which has always been good.
 The driver’s seat has some small tears. We have installed patches over the rips as seen in the photo.
 The little drawer next to the 12v outlet under the center stack is stuck open as seen in the photo.
 The AC is not quite as strong as it used to be. I give it a little AC Pro recharge before summer and it carries me through the warm weather comfortably.
The car has never been in an accident, and the exterior is in good condition for its age. Virtually no rust anywhere. There is a 1 1/4” receiver hitch on the car. This was only ever used for bike carriers. The car has never been used to tow anything.
Except as to the driver’s seat, the interior is in very good condition for its age. The car has never been smoked in. This was the top of the line when bought, and the car includes cruise control, front seat heaters, a power sunroof, a day/night mirror with compass, an upgraded audio system, a cargo area privacy shield that can be easily removed for loading larger items and a roof rack.
Because of the car’s age the sale of course will be on an “AS IS” basis, Sale for cash only (or a cashier’s or certified check). The asking price is well within KBB estimated sale values for this car with this mileage. Please no low-ball or trade offers.
Some extras: I will include the aftermarket Car Play/Android Auto system seen in the photos after I reset it. It works well as both a Navigation system and for playing music from a bluetooth connected phone. The sale will also include the original owner’s manual for the car.
Please contact me through the Craigslist reply system if you are interested, preferably including a text/phone number where I can reach you.

VIN: 
Clean title.

This Mustang was optioned with the leather steering wheel and rear spoiler. Has 4 carpet floor mats and Weathertech liners for the driver and front passenger.
 
These 2010-2014 models have cosmetic issues with hood lip paint bubbling, door card leather peeling, and steering wheel buttons flaking. 
We did a sand and repaint on the hood lip about 3 years ago; it could use a touch up (see photos).
For the peeling door leather, I tried aftermarket panels but those are cheap hard feeling glossy plastics molded to appear leather, so I cut my own soft touch vinyl instead as replacements. 
Buttons have minimal wear. 
There are a few tiny knicks and dings (see above photos).
May need standard maintenance just due to age, but it runs and drives fantastic.
